content.subject: Re: Revised price list - NutriPaws (new rates from 10th Nov)
content.body:
Dear Meera,

Thank you for your revised price list. A 15.0% increase would put our shelf prices far above the market, so we cannot accept it as asked.

What we can accept is 4.7% on all four lines: NP-01 at ₹157.05, NP-02 at ₹172.75, NP-04 at ₹73.29 and NP-05 at ₹81.67.

Our agreement asks for 30 days notice, so the earliest effective date we can agree is 25 November 2026 rather than 10 November 2026.

Regards,
Category team
